intent: Facebook needs a strong first line; TikTok and Reels need the topic in the opening on-screen text and caption.
examples: ChatGPT privacy: what does deleting a chat actually remove?
conventions: Keep Facebook’s first line under 125 characters and TikTok’s caption under 150.
Preserve source scope, native punctuation and platform hashtag limits.
Use the 0–3 second opening as the visual hook.
sounds_false: Link in bio when no link is configured.
#foryou #viral as a substitute for the actual topic.

overrides.name: Native first lines and search-led captions
